title: Design System: Conjunction Ecosystems

display.purpose: Hero H1 only, gold, stacked lines, max 14ch.

headline.purpose: Section H2s in gold, followed by the 40x3 graphite rule.

title.purpose: Service names and feature project title in graphite; sub-section titles in gold.

title-sm.purpose: Project and partner names; card and callout labels in gold (20px bold qualifies as large text).

statement.purpose: Hero lede fixed at 24px so its gold phrase is large text; mission and vision at clamp(1.25rem, 1.8vw, 1.5rem).

lead.purpose: Graphite-soft paragraph beside a section headline, max 56ch.

body-sm.purpose: Nav, arrow links, tab and accordion meta, location lines.

label.purpose: Tracked caps: 0N / SECTION eyebrows (Forest or Rose Ink), column heads, Mission/Vision, footer tagline.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Focused input, with a Forest border. The only shadow in the system.

filters.name: hero-warm
filters.purpose: Warms the hero photo's blue sky toward the ivory ground.

filters.name: portrait-rest
filters.purpose: Portraits at rest; hover returns to full color over 500ms.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for every transition and entrance.

motion.name: state-rule
motion.purpose: Nav underline scale-in, arrow nudge, header hairline, accordion rotate.

motion.name: portrait-color
motion.purpose: Portrait grayscale to color on hover.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.purpose: Hero headline lines, copy and tabs rise 18px.

motion.name: hero-reveal
motion.purpose: Hero photo clip-path reveal top to bottom. Reduced motion: static.

narrative.overview:
This is the client's pinned brand system (`Conjunction-Ecosystems-Web-Brand-Design.md`, extracted from the reference deck) applied to a large-firm consulting homepage. The whole page stays on one warm ivory ground, with no pure white, no pure black and no dark blocks. Credibility comes from restraint. Gold headlines set large and tight carry the voice. Forest and Old Rose alternate as the only chromatic accents, and a single grotesque (Archivo) does all the work. Emphasis comes from a colored border or colored text. Filled panels are never used for emphasis.

The page is editorial, not a dashboard. It follows the brand's 60 / 30 / 10 split of space, content and accent: wide gutters, a large vertical section rhythm, and sections separated by 1px hairlines. Inside a section, content sits either in hairline-ruled rows (comparison table, services, accordions, platform list) or in ivory cards with a thin border. Cards are never a different fill from the page. Every content section opens with a numbered tracked-caps label, a gold headline and a short graphite rule.

Motion is spent on one moment. On load, the hero headline lines rise in sequence and the hero photo reveals top-down through a clip-path. Everything else is short state feedback: nav underlines drawing in, arrows nudging, a hairline appearing under the header on scroll, portraits returning to color. Reduced motion removes all of it. (The direction contract described a header turning white and a scale-in photo. The build keeps the header ivory and adds only a hairline, and it reveals the photo with a clip rather than a scale. The build is the record.)
keyCharacteristics: Ivory Linen ground everywhere, with Graphite text. No `#FFFFFF`, no `#000000`, and no dark fills in UI.
Gold for headlines and large key phrases only. Forest and Rose alternate across sets, one accent per element.
One family, Archivo 400–800. Headlines are bold with negative tracking. Labels are small tracked caps.
Numbered section labels ("0N / SECTION"), a gold H2, and a 40×3 graphite rule under it.
Ivory cards with a 1px `line` border and 12px radius. The active state is a 2px Forest border.
Pills everywhere a shape is interactive or a tag: buttons, tags, the language toggle, the skip link.
Flat. The only shadow in the system is the focus halo on form fields.

rules.name: The No Black, No White Rule
rules.body: The ground is always Ivory Linen and dark text is always Graphite. Neither `#FFFFFF` nor `#000000` appears in UI. Third-party artwork is content, not UI: the Tropical Trash logo keeps its own black ground inside an 8px-radius frame.

rules.name: The Gold Is Large Rule
rules.body: Gold text appears only at 24px or larger, or 18.66px or larger in bold (large text, 3.3:1). That covers the H1, H2, gold H3, 20px bold card and callout labels, and the 24px hero lede phrase. Gold is never a button, a fill, a border or small text.

rules.name: The Ink Variant Rule
rules.body: Rose text at small sizes always uses Rose Ink (#A34A62). Old Rose (#B5566F) stays for fills, icon strokes and markers.

rules.name: The One Accent Per Element Rule
rules.body: Each pill, badge, icon, card and eyebrow takes one accent, Forest or Rose. Across a set (hero tabs, values, service rows, platform items, section eyebrows) they alternate Forest, Rose, Forest.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo is the only typeface. Hierarchy comes from size, weight and color, never from a second face.

rules.name: The Color Not Weight Rule
rules.body: Emphasis inside running text switches color (gold at large sizes, Forest otherwise) at the same weight, as the hero lede does.

rules.name: The Numbered Label Rule
rules.body: Every content section opens with a label in the pattern "0N / SECTION" (tracked caps, 12px, 600). It is set in Forest or Rose Ink, alternating by section, and sits above the gold H2. This is the brand file's own eyebrow pattern and it is intentional. The hero uses the unnumbered tagline format (middle-dot separated, graphite-soft), and group labels inside a section (Personas, Empresas aliadas) sit on a 1px graphite rule.

rules.name: The Short Rule Rule
rules.body: A 40×3px graphite bar sits 24px under the headline in the hero and in every section head. It is a mark, never a full underline.

rules.name: The Wide Margin Rule
rules.body: When a section feels crowded, remove content or add space before adding color or a container (60 / 30 / 10).

rules.name: The Border Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Emphasis raises a border, never a surface. An active card goes from 1px `line` to 2px Forest, and no card, section or button is ever filled dark for contrast.

rules.name: The Open Ring Rule
rules.body: The C mark is Forest on top and Rose on the bottom, with the gap on the right. It is never closed and never recolored.

dos: **Do** keep every surface on Ivory Linen (#F3F0E9) and every dark text in Graphite (#2B2B2E).
**Do** set gold only at 24px or larger, or 18.66px or larger in bold. Use it for headlines, sub-titles, card labels and large key phrases.
**Do** use Rose Ink (#A34A62) for any rose text, and Old Rose (#B5566F) only for fills, strokes and markers.
**Do** alternate Forest and Rose across a set, with one accent per element.
**Do** open content sections with "0N / SECTION", a gold H2 and the 40×3 graphite rule.
**Do** show emphasis with a 2px Forest border on an ivory card, or with colored text.
**Do** use pill buttons: Forest fill with Forest Deep hover, or a 1.5px Forest outline.
**Do** separate sections and rows with 1px `line` hairlines, and open tables and lists with a 1px graphite rule.
**Do** keep motion to the hero entrance plus short state feedback, and honor reduced motion.
**Do** frame photography at 12px radius, and warm cool skies toward the ivory.
donts: **Don't** use `#FFFFFF` or `#000000` in UI. Third-party logo art keeps its own ground as content only.
**Don't** fill a card, button, band or section with a dark color for contrast.
**Don't** use gold as a button, fill, border or small text.
**Don't** set Old Rose (#B5566F) as small text.
**Don't** mix Forest and Rose inside one element, except the two-tone C ring.
**Don't** add shadows beyond the field focus halo.
**Don't** use filled or solid icons outside the circular badges.
**Don't** use AI or sci-fi imagery (robots, neural nets, particles, glow).

knownGaps: Partner/specialist portraits and the Live-Act logo are low-res legacy extracts (320px / small) pending originals.
CPC section (with video) and internal pages are not built yet; extend with the components above.
Field Stroke #8C8474 measures about 1.9:1 on ivory, below the 3:1 non-text target; recorded as shipped, not as a proven value.
Language toggle pressed state fills Graphite, which the brand file bans as a fill; not canonized.
Specialist accordions mix a Forest toggle with Old Rose list bullets inside one element; not canonized.
